tasks.label: Push current branch to device
tasks.command: cd /Users/travisbadgley/openpilot && CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current) && case "$CURRENT_BRANCH" in ody-*) ;; *) echo "\u274c Refusing to deploy '$CURRENT_BRANCH' - checkout an ody-* branch first." && exit 1 ;; esac && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo '\u274c Refusing to deploy: openpilot has uncommitted changes.' && git status --short && exit 1; fi && if [ -n "$(git -C opendbc_repo status --porcelain)" ]; then echo '\u274c Refusing to deploy: opendbc_repo has uncommitted changes.' && git -C opendbc_repo status --short && exit 1; fi && SUB_BRANCH=$(git -C opendbc_repo branch --show-current) && if [ "$SUB_BRANCH" != "$CURRENT_BRANCH" ]; then echo "\u274c Refusing to deploy: parent is $CURRENT_BRANCH but opendbc_repo is $SUB_BRANCH." && exit 1; fi && PINNED=$(git ls-tree HEAD opendbc_repo | awk '{print $3}') && ACTUAL=$(git -C opendbc_repo rev-parse HEAD) && if [ "$PINNED" != "$ACTUAL" ]; then echo "\u274c Refusing to deploy: parent pins $PINNED but opendbc_repo is at $ACTUAL." && exit 1; fi && git diff --check && git -C opendbc_repo diff --check && .venv/bin/python .agents/preflash.py && echo "\ud83d\ude97 Deploying tested $CURRENT_BRANCH to device..." && git -C opendbc_repo push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" && git push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" && ssh comma@192.168.1.200 "bash -l -c \"cd /data/openpilot && (git remote set-url origin https://github.com/brikowski/openpilot.git || git remote add origin https://github.com/brikowski/openpilot.git) && tools/op.sh switch origin $CURRENT_BRANCH && tools/op.sh build && (sudo reboot &) && exit 0\""

tasks.label: Checkout branch
tasks.command: git checkout ${input:branchChoice} && cd opendbc_repo && git checkout ${input:branchChoice}

tasks.label: Run Cabana
tasks.command: ARG="${input:cabanaArg}" && uv run scons openpilot/tools/cabana/_cabana openpilot/cereal/messaging/bridge && if [ "$ARG" = "live" ]; then uv run openpilot/tools/cabana/_cabana --zmq tcp://192.168.1.200; else uv run openpilot/tools/cabana/_cabana "$ARG"; fi

tasks.label: Inspect Upstream Delta
tasks.detail: Read-only comparison after fetching: shows openpilot divergence, the compatible opendbc pin, and both net file lists. Does not rebase, push, or deploy.
tasks.command: git fetch upstream && git -C opendbc_repo fetch upstream && PINNED=$(git ls-tree upstream/master opendbc_repo | awk '{print $3}') && test -n "$PINNED" && echo "openpilot behind/ahead:" && git rev-list --left-right --count upstream/master...HEAD && echo "opendbc behind/ahead vs compatible pin $PINNED:" && git -C opendbc_repo rev-list --left-right --count $PINNED...HEAD && echo "net openpilot tree delta:" && git diff --stat HEAD..upstream/master && echo "net compatible opendbc tree delta:" && git -C opendbc_repo diff --stat HEAD..$PINNED

tasks.label: Sync Upstream Locally (rebase, keep history)
tasks.detail: Rebases onto openpilot master and exactly the opendbc commit it pins. Resolves only gitlink conflicts and never pushes; run checks before publishing.

tasks.label: Publish Validated Rebased Branches
tasks.detail: Runs the complete check gate, then explicitly force-with-lease publishes both rebased tuning branches. Does not deploy to the device.
tasks.command: CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current) && case "$CURRENT_BRANCH" in ody-op|ody-op-long) ;; *) echo "Refusing to publish $CURRENT_BRANCH" && exit 1 ;; esac && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && test -z "$(git -C opendbc_repo status --porcelain)" && test "$(git -C opendbc_repo branch --show-current)" = "$CURRENT_BRANCH" && test "$(git ls-tree HEAD opendbc_repo | awk '{print $3}')" = "$(git -C opendbc_repo rev-parse HEAD)" && git -C opendbc_repo push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" --force-with-lease && git push origin "$CURRENT_BRANCH" --force-with-lease

tasks.label: Generate Longitudinal Maneuver Report (local route)
tasks.detail: Official openpilot closed-loop report. The route may be an SSH-pulled bare local id; public comma connect upload is not required.

tasks.label: Generate Lateral Maneuver Report (local route)
tasks.detail: Official openpilot lateral maneuver report for a locally pulled route. Only use a route recorded in Lateral Maneuver Mode.

tasks.label: Validate New Logs (pull from device)
tasks.detail: Pull every unvalidated route in the selected window over SSH, retain the private full-rate rlogs locally, and run the Odyssey invariant/trend validator. Needs the device powered and on wifi.

tasks.label: Validate Log (pull one route from device)
tasks.detail: Pull and retain one private full-rate route over SSH, then run the custom invariant/trend validator. Accepts a bare log id or dongle/logid.

tasks.label: Validate Log (comma API)
tasks.detail: Validate straight from comma's servers - no device needed, but only works if the route is public AND its rlog was manually uploaded in connect. rlogs never auto-upload.

tasks.label: Run Checks
tasks.detail: Static checks, pure custom-metric tests, opendbc unit/safety tests, interface tests, and the Odyssey preflash gate. Does not grade ride quality.
tasks.command:
echo '🔍 Checking your custom repository code syntax...' && \
uv run ruff check opendbc_repo && \
.venv/bin/ruff check .agents --ignore ISC002 && \
.venv/bin/python -m pytest .agents/test_validate_log.py -q && \
opendbc_repo/test.sh && \
uv run pytest opendbc_repo/opendbc/car/tests/test_car_interfaces.py && \
.venv/bin/python .agents/preflash.py
